title: isotrema dilatatum
intro: Isotrema dilatatum, commonly known as the "Bhui Gharuwa" in Nepali, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used in various parts of the world for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as the reduction of inflammation and the alleviation of pain. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids like isoretrone and isorhynchophylline, that exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, making Isotrema dilatatum a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
